name: The Crew: The Quest for Planet Nine
summary: Cooperative trick-taking card game where players must complete assigned task objectives across 50 escalating missions.
rules_text: Shuffle 40 cards (36 color cards in 4 suits numbered 1-9 and 4 rockets as trump) and deal face down equally. Player with rocket 4 is commander and leads first trick. Clockwise each player plays one card following the lead suit if possible; rocket may only be played if unable to follow color. Highest card of the lead suit wins unless a rocket is played, then highest rocket wins. Winner leads next trick. Before a mission, reveal task cards equal to mission number; starting with commander, players draft them. A player fulfills a task when winning a trick that contains that exact card. All tasks must be fulfilled to win the mission, otherwise all lose. Communication is forbidden except once per mission each player may place a card face up before a trick and mark it with a token as highest, lowest, or only card of that color. Rockets cannot be communicated.
